excerpt: Nash, one of the busier DJs to have emerged out of New Delhi, debuts as a producer with a release on globally prominent artist Nina Las Vegas' NLV Records, remixing her track with Swick, 'Shot Caller', which features singer-songwriter Zanillya. Nash's remix affixes the immaculately percussive original to the recognisable and more constant syntax of UK garage with the low-end taking precendence except for the afro-influenced breakdown.
